name: The Beach Barbers

seo.title: The Beach Barbers | Barbers in Blackpool
seo.description: Barbers at 128 Highfield Road, Blackpool. Skin fades, scissor cuts, beard trims and the Kurdish hot towel shave. Walk in Mon–Sat 9am–6pm, or call 07398 989866.

hoursNote: Walk in any time. Last cut goes in the chair before 6pm.

intro.text: A Kurdish barbers on Highfield Road, South Shore. No booking, no fuss, and every cut finished with a hot towel.

services.label: The menu
services.heading: What we do.
services.intro: Sit down, say what you want, and the barber takes it from there. Fades, scissor work, beards and the shave the sign is famous for.
services.pricingNote: Your barber quotes the price before the first snip, so there are no surprises at the till.

items.name: Skin fade
items.note: Taken down clean and blended tight. Lined up to finish.

items.name: Scissor cut
items.note: All scissors, shaped to how you actually wear it.

items.name: Beard trim
items.note: Shaped, lined and edged. Hot towel included.

items.name: Kurdish hot towel shave
items.note: Steam, hot towels, a straight razor and a cold towel to close. The one on the sign.

items.name: Head shave
items.note: Down to the skin, with a hot towel to settle it.

items.name: Cut & beard
items.note: Any cut on the list with the beard done to match.

members.name: Nik
members.line: Knowledgeable and chatty, in the words of the reviews. The perfect combination if you like a barber who talks you through it.

members.name: Lucas
members.line: The newer chair, and already the reason first-timers come back. Treated nicely, cut properly.

offer.label: The signature
offer.heading: Hot towel shave.
offer.body: It is on the sign for a reason. Hot towels to open the skin, a straight razor taken slowly, then a cold towel and balm to close it down. Twenty minutes in the chair and you walk out on Highfield Road feeling brand new.

paragraphs: The Beach Barbers is a Kurdish barbershop at 128 Highfield Road, South Shore, a short walk from the Pleasure Beach end of town. Skin fades, scissor cuts and beards, all finished the old way with steam and a hot towel.
Sports on the telly while you wait, a clean shop, and barbers who ask what you want and then do exactly that. Walk in Monday to Saturday until 6pm.
